summary: Validated backend implementation of (1) teacher manual override (final_grade_manual) on /api/teacher/grades and (2) optional 'Nota a Padres' column in conducta + show_padres_grade settings flag. 12/14 pytest tests pass; 2 skipped due to seed-data limitations (NOT bugs). All target endpoints behave per spec; code review confirms consolidado + ranking honour final_grade_manual.

minor.issue: Returns 500 for a valid teacher (rafa, id=5d8c199d-...). Probably a missing field (level_id/grade_id) on legacy 'tutor' assignment causing enrichment crash. The filter-style endpoint /api/academic/assignments?teacher_id=... works fine.
Filter params (role, seccion_id) are ignored by the endpoint — full users list is returned. Test had to filter client-side. Consider supporting query filters or document the limitation.

action_items: (Optional) Honour role/seccion_id filters on /api/users to ease testing & frontend filtering.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/grades.py L576-577 + L771-772 correctly prefer final_grade_manual over final_grade in grades_lookup (verified by code review).
services/ranking.py L93-97 correctly applies same precedence inside compute_ranking (verified by code review).
routes/teacher_portal.py L530-657 well structured: per-payload range validation, period existence check, 403 when teacher lacks assignment, $unset on grade=null, idempotent $setOnInsert upsert.
routes/conduct.py L219-224 wraps padres validation with HTTPException re-raise prefixed 'Nota a padres:' as required.
routes/libreta.py L329-332 + L661 expose metadata.show_padres_grade in the libreta payload (default False).
routes/settings.py L130-140 GET /settings exposes show_padres_grade; L216-258 PUT /settings/roles persists it on schools collection. Allowed_fields list includes the new flag.
